curated.title: 📰 Quantum Computing Weekly
curated.audience: Engineers and technically curious professionals who follow quantum computing but do not read papers daily, plus newcomers. They want to know what changed, whether it is real, and what to watch.
curated.angle: Quantum claims are often oversold. Separate genuine progress (error rates, logical qubits, hardware runs, resource estimates) from simulations and asymptotic promises, and say how far each result is from practical use.
curated.signoff:
That's this week's Quantum Computing Weekly. If one idea here changed how you see the field, pass it on, and tell me what you want covered next.

Best regards,
Hyunho
